name: When should I schedule a site feasibility consultation?
description: Schedule a consultation early, ideally before purchasing land or finalizing designs, to identify potential issues and costs upfront.

mainEntity.name: When should I schedule a site feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is best to schedule a site feasibility consultation early in your tiny home planning process, ideally before purchasing land or finalizing design plans. This ensures that the property can accommodate your desired tiny home and helps you understand any potential costs or challenges upfront. An early consultation can prevent costly surprises and rework later, setting a solid foundation for your project's success.
